description: Treat an explicitly configured but unreachable test database as a failure. The reachability helper collapses every exception to a boolean, so in the job where the database URL is set a real connection or auth failure degrades to a skip and the job exits zero. Remove the boolean rather than adding a flag to it — discarding the exception is what erased the diagnosis.
expectedBehavior: With the database URL set and the database unreachable, the suite exits non-zero and the driver's error message is visible
With no database URL set, the suite still skips with its stated reason and exits zero
verificationSteps: Stop the compose db, then run the migration suite with TEST_DATABASE_URL set and confirm it fails with the connection error rather than skipping
Start the compose db and confirm the same command passes
Run the migration suite with no TEST_DATABASE_URL and confirm it skips with a reason
